_schema.about: Source of truth for the Apps page (apps/index.html). Edit this file, then run python3 scripts/build_apps.py. Statuses are only ever set from a real test run.

apps[].name: display name
apps[].icon: built-in inline SVG name ('node', 'python', 'terminal', 'grid') or a path under assets/ (e.g. 'assets/project-icons/atrium.png')
apps[].kind: how it reaches the system, e.g. 'Prebuilt binary', 'Desktop session'
apps[].workflow: list of the concrete steps the test performs, in order
apps[].install: {label, snippet}: a copy-ready way to get it on Omnix
apps[].verification: null until a maintainer or agent runs the test; then {status, verified_at (YYYY-MM-DD), commit (tested repo commit), notes, log_excerpt}
apps[].known_gaps: optional list of documented gaps from the test file (shown on the card; not a status)

_schema.candidates[]: apps not tested yet: {id, name, icon, category, description}. Always rendered as untested.
_schema.statuses: passing | known-gap | failing | untested. passing, known-gap and failing require test.path and verification.verified_at, or the build fails.

apps.name: Node.js 22.12
apps.description: The official linux-x64 tarball from nodejs.org, unpacked and run as shipped.
workflow: systemd-run --wait --pipe /opt/node/bin/node -e 'console.log(1)'  (a service without nix-ld's session variables)

apps.name: Python 3.12.8
apps.description: astral-sh's python-build-standalone build, unpacked and run as shipped.
known_gaps: A script with #!/usr/bin/python3 resolved through envfs fails for relocatable interpreters like this one; the test expects that failure until Mic92/envfs#233 ships in nixpkgs.

apps.name: KDE Plasma - Atrium
apps.description: Omnix's KDE Plasma desktop, booted to a real Plasma Wayland session.
workflow: Boot to the display manager and auto-login a new user
plasmashell and kwin_wayland start for that user
Distribution defaults reach the user: Atrium look-and-feel, key repeat delay 250, per-screen virtual desktops
Take a screenshot of the session

install.label: flake.nix

apps.name: Hyprland - Omarchy (stable)
apps.description: Omarchy's own Hyprland config, themes and scripts on the Omnix base, pinned to a stable release.
workflow: Boot to the display manager and auto-login a new user
The user's config is seeded from Omarchy's templates (~/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua, omarchy-theme-set on PATH)
Hyprland starts on Omarchy's Lua config and opens its instance socket
Take a screenshot of the session

install.label: flake.nix
